-
Hon'ble Shri Justice Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi Order on Board 17-10-2023
1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the applicant, who has been arrested on 16-5-2023 in connection with Crime No. 403/2022 registered at Police Station Shivarinarayan, Distt. Janjgir - Champa (C.G.), for the offence punishable under Section 307, 498A, 34 of the IPC.
2. Allegation against the applicant is that marriage of complainant Priti Kosariya was performed with present applicant in the year 2017, they have been blessed with a girl child also.
It is alleged that applicant and other co-accused persons used to torture her on demand of dowry.

On 8-12-2022,
complainant was preparing meals, at that time, co-accused persons committed marpeet with her and co-accused Kirti Kosariya administered her some poisonous substance

. It is further alleged that at that time, present applicant asked them over phone to kill her by burning, therefore, co-accused Kirti Kosariya and Ritika Kosariya pored kerosene upon her and attempted to kill her.
Based on above facts, present crime has been registered against applicant and other co-accused persons and the applicant was arrested on 16- 12-2022.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is not a case of dowry harassment.

As per case of prosecution itself, at the time of alleged Rajkumar Kosariya vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50339550/
1 incident, the applicant was not present at the spot and only on the basis of general and omnibus type of statement, present applicant and his family members are implicated in the instant case.

entities.text: Rajkumar Kosariya vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that charge sheet has been filed.
Hence the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the contrary, while opposing the bail application, learned State counsel submits that applicant and his family members not only tortured the complainant for demand of dowry, but they also attempted to kill her by administering poisonous substance and also pored kerosene on her body.

Therefore, the application for grant of bail is liable to be rejected.
5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record and on the case diary.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly considering the fact that in the FIR, applicant has not been named, even in dying declaration of victim/complainant, she has alleged only her mother-in-law, father-in-law,
elder brother-in-law, elder sister-in-law Sas, their two minor children, the applicant is in jail since 16-12-2022, and considering the totality of the facts of the case, I feel inclined to release the applicant on bail.
7.

Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the trial court regularly on each and every date as per direction of the court, unless exempted from appearance.

It is also directed that applicant and the surety shall submit a copy of their Adhaar card along with a coloured postcard full size photo having printed the Adhar card number on it, which shall be verified by the concerned trial Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

Sd/-
(Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) Judge Pathak/-
